name: Tablet of the Seven
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I came to the Burning Steppes, following the legends of the Seven.  They were dwarves of great knowledge and power, and if you have knowledge and power, then wealth is sure to follow.

That's what I want.  Wealth!

If we can learn more of the Seven, then maybe we can get rich together.  The ruins of Thaurissan is rumored to keep the Tablet of the Seven, which holds knowledge of the ancient dwarves.  Find this tablet, copy its text and bring it to me.  Let's discover its secrets together!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, you found the tablet! And your transcription is superb! Are you sure you're a Champion and not a scribe?

Here you are, adventurer. Here is the payment I promised.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the writings of the Seven, adventurer? Have you learned the secrets from their tablet?
